d: France has been witnessing a wave of anti-government protests, with demonstrations over rising living costs, strained public services and poor school conditions turning violent across major cities. From torched buildings and looted shops to thousands of arrests and allegations of police brutality, the unrest has triggered a wider debate over civil liberties, state power and public anger. With President Emmanuel Macron facing mounting pressure ahead of the 2027 presidential election, what is driving the protests, and why is the government's response adding to the crisis?
